_comment: Expected azx output per E2E fixture. Derived from validated local `azx plan --json` runs, NOT hand-predicted. plan-match (needs + resources + region) is the deterministic contract and must hold exactly. compile/whatif encode the CURRENTLY-KNOWN outcome incl. documented azx codegen bugs; when a bug is fixed and a gate flips, the harness fails on purpose so these expectations get updated to track reality.

next-openai.whatifKnownIssue: environment/product signal, not a codegen bug: azx faithfully emits the requested model (gpt-4o, newest grounded version 2024-11-20), but every gpt-4o/gpt-4.1/gpt-4o-mini version is retired/deprecating in this target catalog's clock, so CognitiveServices preflight rejects the deployment. An offline tool cannot track live model lifecycle; the honest options are live catalog lookup, a maintained version map, or omit-and-document. Compile + subdomain + explicit-version fixes are all correct; this gate stays FAIL until the catalog carries a GA gpt-4o (or azx gains live lookup).
